picks.name: Milwaukie Porchfest
picks.description: Musicians play live sets from front porches throughout Milwaukie as visitors wander the streets discovering music. Free, casual, and community-driven.

picks.name: Zootopia 2
picks.description: Free outdoor screening of Zootopia 2 at Khunamokwst Park in NE Portland. Bring a blanket and snacks — movie starts at 7:30pm so arrive early for a good spot on the grass.

picks.name: Cathedral Park Jazz Fest
picks.description: Portland's longest-running free jazz festival returns to Cathedral Park beneath the St. Johns Bridge. Multiple days of live jazz — bring a blanket and make a whole day of it.

picks.name: Canterbury Ren Faire
picks.description: The 16th annual Canterbury Renaissance Faire in Silverton features jousting, costumes, vendors, food, and entertainment all day. About 45 minutes south of Portland — worth the trip.

picks.name: Fuji to Hood Festival
picks.description: A cultural arts festival celebrating the connection between Japan and Oregon — music, art, food, and performance at The Redd on Salmon Street. A uniquely Portland afternoon.

picks.name: Portland Pride Parade
picks.description: Portland Pride Parade rolls through Downtown — one of the biggest Pride celebrations in the Pacific Northwest. Come to cheer, march, or just soak in the energy of one of the city's most joyful days.

picks.name: Spain vs Argentina
picks.description: The World Cup Final. Portland's soccer bars will be packed — check PDX Monthly's viewing guide to find the best spot to watch with a crowd. Kickoff at noon.

picks.name: Cats of Sunnyside Walk
picks.description: A neighborhood cat walk through Sunnyside where residents show off their beloved cats along a mapped route. Free and genuinely delightful — please be respectful of the neighbors and the cats.
